summary: Provides the protocol mechanisms for using ECC Brainpool curves with TLS 1.3. These curves were options in TLS 1.2, were dropped for TLS 1.3 because of little use, and have not been shown to be significantly weak, so some people still want them.

eli5.summary: Some special math shapes used for secret handshakes were removed from the newest version of the web's lock. This lets people put several of them back.
